candidates.change_summary: owner() now returns _msgSender() instead of the stored _owner, changing the returned owner to the current caller.
owner() now returns address(0) unconditionally, causing owner() to always report the zero address.
owner() now returns tx.origin instead of the stored _owner, exposing the externally-owned originator as the owner.
owner() now returns address(this), so the contract reports itself as the owner.
owner() returns the stored _owner XORed with a constant, producing a different address result deterministically.
Removed the require that newOwner is non-zero, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero address if called by owner.
Changed onlyOwner to check against tx.origin instead of msg.sender, altering which callers are allowed to invoke owner-only functions like transferOwnership.
